reason: Automatic approval review flagged an apparent conflict between optional precise-location collection and the policy wording.
verifiedBehavior: Workout GPS routes default off. Settings enables them and HealthKit route authorization is requested.
WorkoutReader.swift includes precise latitude and longitude in the workout payload only when routesEnabled is true.
APIClient.swift encrypts the complete payload before PUT upload.
storage.ts stores the encrypted envelope in private R2 and indexes it under the authenticated account.
The iOS privacy manifest already declares precise location for app functionality, linked to user, without tracking.
policyClarification: The published policy explicitly distinguishes enabled GPS/reproductive records retained in encrypted account files from the separate unencrypted catalog, which contains no precise coordinates.
appleGuidanceReviewed: The optional disclosure and opt-in sections require considering ongoing data collection after permission, rather than omitting a type solely because its feature defaults off.
